current_activity: XC Corps (Petersen) takes over almost all the Vosges assault forces on 12 January
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 27 p. 522: "The decision became effective on 12 January, with the XXXIX Panzer Corps headquarters and the 10th SS Panzer and 7th Parachute Divisions going to Himmler; with the 21st Panzer, 25th Panzer Grenadier, and 47th Volksgrenadier Divisions (upon arriving) coming under Hoehne's LXXXIX Corps, moving out of the Vosges; and with almost all of the Vosges assault forces taken over by Petersen's XC Corps". Event definition: the day the decision became effective, 12 January. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Obersteinbach with a precision of 25 km, a representative point in the northern Vosges for the corps sector; the passage names the Vosges only. Location approximate: a representative point in the northern Vosges. Location support: CMH names the Vosges. Commander: General Petersen (as named by CMH). Opponents: US Seventh Army (VI Corps).
